source: LIVE pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef via read-only Supabase connector
body_semantic_certification: Only complete SQL declarations and referenced native entrypoint symbols were directly inspected, not compiled C/internal implementation source or hosted HTTP execution.

findings.description: Visible native declarations cover integer/interval/range operations, geometry, JSON/JSONB and JSONPath, international encodings, string comparison and session-local sequence introspection. PostgreSQL-managed implementations and optimizer helpers are not safe objects for unilateral removal.

Direct SQL EXECUTE grants, including native internal functions, do not demonstrate anonymous API reachability, runtime privilege bypass or data disclosure. No potentially state-changing function was invoked.
Compiled C and PostgreSQL internal implementations are not exposed by pg_get_functiondef, so their source-level audit remains UNVERIFIED.
